newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, focus on Cimpor.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, focus on Cimpor.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Portuguese shares closed mixed in firm volume of 9.9 billion escudos, with cement group Cimpor and mobile phone operator Telecel pushing the indices higher. The recovery of international markets after a modest gain in U.S. April prices helped the local bourse. Busy trade in Cimpor during the session was due to optimistic expectations about its results. Cimpor said it posted a sharp increase in consolidated net profit in the first quarter to 3.4 billion escudos, benefiting from good weather. In the same year-ago period, Cimpor posted a net profit of 2.2 billion escudos. Cimpor shares closed on Lisbon bourse at 3,850 escudos, up 79, in turnover of 822,906 shares. Dealers said the trend of the Lisbon bourse tomorrow would depend on international markets. "The market will retain its focus on foreign developments, principally New York," an operator said.
